L089.assumptions: Two loci A/a and B/b. Recombination of AB/ab can give Ab/aB while retaining existing allele versions. A star denotes a new sequence version, not a predicted phenotype. Animal somatic versus reproductive lineage transmission; plants/asexual routes may differ. No need-directed mutation or guaranteed inheritance.
L089.limits: Mutations are not purposeful responses to need; recombination need not create alleles, and animal somatic mutations ordinarily are not inherited.
L089.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L089.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.

L090.assumptions: Deterministic asexual haploid faithful inheritance. Initial A frequency0.5 or0; A/B relative offspring contributions2/1 or1/2. pNext=p*wA/(p*wA+(1-p)*wB). Three rounds, no mutation, migration, drift or density dependence. Proportions not real count forecasts; absent A stays absent.
L090.limits: Fitness is not strength, individuals do not evolve through effort, and selection in this model cannot create absent variation.
L090.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L090.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.

L091.assumptions: Original illustrative rock layers, bone correspondence and fictional100-site alignment AB4/AC18/BC17. Undisturbed layers support relative order; homology needs multiple details and convergence checks. Molecular comparison assumes comparable loci/rates; no date calibration. Drawings are not actual fossils or copied datasets.
L091.limits: One similar trait is not proof by itself; incomplete fossils do not make every historical explanation equally supported.
L091.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L091.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.

L092.assumptions: Fictional taxa Amber/Birch/Cobalt, topology((Amber,Birch),Cobalt). Branch rotation retains common-ancestor groups. Unscaled lengths, no tip rank or living ancestor claim. Reduced gene flow may permit divergence; renewed-contact reproductive evidence is needed, geography alone does not guarantee species.
L092.limits: A tree is not a progress ladder; separation does not guarantee speciation, and unscaled branch lengths are not time.
L092.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L092.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.
